roles.silhouette: Tall, relaxed full-body silhouette with asymmetrical pointing gesture and one hand at the hip.
roles.body_ratio: Long-legged anime proportion, approximately seven to eight heads tall.
roles.head_exaggeration: Slightly enlarged anime head while preserving a slender adult silhouette.
roles.hand_exaggeration: Hands remain readable and lightly emphasized for comedic gestures.
roles.foot_exaggeration: Shoes are clearly readable with modest stylization and stable contact with the ground.
roles.costume_construction: Black cap, short black bob, white collared shirt, brown necktie, dark suspenders, high-waisted loose dark trousers, and black ankle shoes.
roles.line_behavior: Clean anime contour with limited internal linework; benchmark target should introduce slight handmade variation without losing readability.
roles.eye_design: Large rounded blue anime eyes with simple highlights and restrained lashes.
roles.shading_ceiling: Flat color with one restrained cel-shadow layer; no glossy or cinematic rendering.
roles.front_full_body_neutral_target: Preserve the complete costume and proportions in a near-front full-body standing reference with readable hands and shoes.
roles.background_isolation_target: Transparent or plain white background with no props, text, architecture, or scenery.
identity_anchors: short black bob with straight bangs
brown tie and loose dark trousers

roles.silhouette: Upright slim suit silhouette with open presenting palm, closed opposite fist, and long tied-back hair.
roles.body_ratio: Long-legged anime proportion, approximately seven to eight heads tall, slightly narrower and more formal than the boke.
roles.head_exaggeration: Moderately enlarged anime head with a sharper, more assertive expression.
roles.hand_exaggeration: Open palm and closed fist must remain anatomically readable for emphatic responses.
roles.foot_exaggeration: Low formal shoes remain clearly separated from trouser hems and grounded.
roles.costume_construction: Bright blue tailored jacket, white collared shirt, vivid orange tie, dark blue flared trousers, brown formal shoes, and long brown ponytail with shell-like orange hair ornaments.
roles.line_behavior: Simple crisp anime contour with sparse interior detail and flat fills; preserve clarity while avoiding sterile vector uniformity.
roles.eye_design: Narrower magenta anime eyes supporting a confident, teasing tsukkomi expression.
roles.shading_ceiling: Mostly flat color with at most one light cel-shadow layer; no complex highlights or volumetric lighting.
roles.front_full_body_neutral_target: Preserve the suit construction, long ponytail, ornaments, hand gesture, trousers, and shoes in a near-front full-body standing reference.
roles.background_isolation_target: Transparent or plain white background with no props, text, architecture, or scenery.
identity_anchors: orange tie and dark blue trousers
prohibited_ai_traits: melted open palm or closed fist
